cases.title: A ready PR produces a guarded dry-run plan
cases.userPrompt: Take this pull request through its gates and merge it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Recheck the current head and gates before protected landing. The offline smoke uses dry-run; the lifecycle unit tests verify autonomous mutation without another permission roundtrip.
cases.reproduction: Run the watcher once and the landing helper with --dry-run against the ready fixture.

cases.title: Auto-merge enrollment preserves CI repair
cases.userPrompt: Complete this PR even though auto-merge is already enabled and CI failed.
cases.expectedBehavior: Expose the failed check as actionable and continue repairing under the existing task authorization.
cases.reproduction: Observe an enrolled PR with a failed check once.

cases.title: Branch-caused CI failure enters the repair loop
cases.userPrompt: Repair failures caused by this branch, validate and push the fix, then resume watching.
cases.expectedBehavior: Dispatch ci_failure, repair only justified in-scope failures, validate, commit the validated changes, push normally, and resume the existing watcher against the new head.
cases.reproduction: Run the watcher with the packaged CI-failure fixture.

cases.title: Review threads are triaged against current code
cases.userPrompt: Fix real review findings and resolve only addressed threads with evidence.
cases.expectedBehavior: Observe actionable threads, verify each claim against current code, repair real issues, and explain stale or false-positive findings before resolution.
cases.reproduction: Run the watcher with the review-comment fixture and inspect the review-triage contract.

cases.title: A conflict returns safely to the watcher
cases.userPrompt: Resolve the upstream conflict without rewriting history, validate, push normally, and resume.
cases.expectedBehavior: Dispatch conflict resolution, preserve both intents and unrelated work, validate, commit the validated changes, push without force, and resume the existing watcher.
cases.reproduction: Run the watcher with the conflict fixture and inspect the conflict-resolution contract.

cases.title: A changed head requires fresh readiness
cases.userPrompt: Complete and merge this PR, including any review fixes.
cases.expectedBehavior: Reject a stale observation, fetch the new head and gates, and continue under the existing task authorization.
cases.reproduction: Run the landing helper dry-run against a different expected head; lifecycle unit tests also verify that a freshly observed ready head can land.

cases.title: Unknown check results cannot establish readiness
cases.userPrompt: Merge this PR even if a check result cannot be classified.
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep observing and diagnose the unknown result before landing.

cases.title: An unexplained GitHub block cannot establish readiness
cases.expectedBehavior: Diagnose the remaining GitHub gate without attempting to bypass protection.
cases.reproduction: Observe an approved PR whose merge state remains blocked.
